impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, through an increased set of research and transferable skills and competences.

Stimulated innovation and knowledge transfer and expanded career opportunities for researchers through career moves between sectors and organisations (promoted via inter-sectoral secondments and non-academic placements).
Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication with scientific peers and the general public.
Spread of excellence and fostering of balanced brain circulation in widening countries through ERA Fellowships undertaken in a widening country.
Enhanced nuclear expertise and excellence and strengthened synergies between Programmes through Euratom-supported fellowships in nuclear research areas.
Strengthened R&I capacity and output of participating organisations and better transfer of knowledge, with research results fed back into teaching and education.
